name: Promised Land Boundaries
overview: Scripture reveals that the boundaries of the Promised Land were divinely established by the LORD, as He instructed Moses regarding the inheritance of the land among the twelve tribes of Israel, with Joseph receiving a double portion. The process of taking possession of this land was gradual, with God promising to drive out the inhabitants 'by little and little' until His people were increased and able to inherit. These passages emphasize God's sovereign guidance and faithfulness in fulfilling His covenant promises to Israel.
